tables.name: employers
tables.title: Employer Accounts
tables.description: Employer partners (clients) with sector, levy status, account manager and contracted learner targets.

columns.name: employer_name
columns.expr: choice([fake.last_name(), choice(['Albion','Meridian','Northway','Kingsbridge','Oakfield','Riverside','Summit','Beacon','Crown','Highland','Westfield','Granite','Silverline','Redwood','Harbour','Pennant','Lockwood','Ashby','Calder','Severn'])]) + ' ' + choice({'Financial Services':['Capital','Insurance','Building Society','Wealth'],'Retail & Consumer':['Retail','Stores','Brands','Foods'],'Healthcare & NHS':['Health','Care','Medical'],'Public Sector':['Borough Council','District Council','Combined Authority'],'Technology & Telecoms':['Digital','Technologies','Networks','Software'],'Utilities & Energy':['Energy','Power','Water'],'Professional Services':['Consulting','Partners','Advisory','Legal'],'Charity & Third Sector':['Trust','Foundation','Charity'],'Logistics & Transport':['Logistics','Freight','Transport'],'Manufacturing':['Engineering','Manufacturing','Industries'],'Hospitality':['Hotels','Leisure','Hospitality'],'Construction':['Construction','Homes','Build']}[sector]) + ('' if sector in ('Public Sector','Charity & Third Sector') else choice([' Ltd',' Ltd',' Group',' plc','',' LLP' if sector=='Professional Services' else ' Ltd']))

columns.name: email_domain
columns.expr: ''.join(ch for ch in employer_name.lower().replace(' plc', '').replace(' ltd', '').replace(' group', '').replace(' and ', '') if ch.isalnum())[:20] + '.co.uk'

columns.name: annual_levy_gbp
columns.expr: (rnd.randint(1500, 9000) if tier == 'Strategic' else rnd.randint(400, 2500) if tier == 'Key' else rnd.randint(60, 900)) * 1000 if levy_payer else 0

tables.name: employees
tables.title: Staff Directory
tables.description: All Delcorn employees (named personas plus wider staff), with role, manager, location, salary and coach caseload targets. Confidential: contains salary data.

columns.name: job_title
columns.expr: choice({'delivery': ['Skills Coach (Data)', 'Skills Coach (Data)', 'Skills Coach (Data)', 'Skills Coach (AI)', 'Skills Coach (AI)', 'Skills Coach (AI)', 'Skills Coach (Digital)', 'Skills Coach (Digital)', 'Skills Coach (Leadership)', 'Skills Coach (Leadership)', 'Skills Coach (Leadership)', 'Skills Coach (People)', 'Skills Coach (Project Management)', 'Functional Skills Tutor (Maths & English)', 'Learner Engagement Officer', 'Delivery Coordinator'], 'curriculum': ['Curriculum Developer', 'Learning Designer', 'Content Coordinator', 'Workshop Facilitator'], 'quality': ['Quality Officer', 'Compliance Officer', 'Data Quality Officer'], 'safeguarding': ['Safeguarding Officer', 'Learner Support Adviser', 'Wellbeing Practitioner'], 'partnerships': ['Client Partner', 'Business Development Executive', 'Marketing Executive', 'Bid Writer', 'Employer Engagement Coordinator'], 'finance': ['Finance Assistant', 'Credit Controller', 'Funding Officer'], 'people': ['HR Adviser', 'Recruitment Coordinator', 'People Systems Administrator'], 'tech': ['IT Support Analyst', 'Systems Analyst', 'Data Engineer', 'Power BI Developer'], 'hub': ['Internal Communications Officer', 'Office & Events Coordinator']}[department])

columns.name: role_family
columns.expr: 'Coach' if 'Skills Coach' in job_title else ('Tutor' if 'Tutor' in job_title else ('Leadership' if any(k in job_title for k in ['Chief', 'Director', 'Head of']) else ('Manager' if 'Manager' in job_title or 'Lead' in job_title else 'Specialist')))

columns.name: academy
columns.expr: next((v for k, v in {'(AI)': 'AI Academy', '(Data)': 'Data Academy', '(Digital)': 'Digital Academy', '(Leadership)': 'Leadership Academy', '(Project Management)': 'Leadership Academy', '(People)': 'People Academy'}.items() if k in job_title), None)

columns.name: manager_id
columns.expr: (('P012' if academy in ('AI Academy', 'Data Academy', 'Digital Academy') else 'P013') if role_family == 'Coach' else next(dd['head'] for dd in company['departments'] if dd['id'] == department))

columns.name: salary_gbp
columns.expr: round(rnd.randint(165000, 195000) if 'Chief Executive' in job_title else rnd.randint(140000, 165000) if 'Chief' in job_title else rnd.randint(105000, 130000) if 'Director' in job_title else rnd.randint(72000, 90000) if 'Head of' in job_title else rnd.randint(52000, 64000) if ('Manager' in job_title or 'Lead' in job_title) else rnd.randint(40000, 46000) if 'Senior' in job_title else rnd.randint(34000, 41000) if role_family in ('Coach', 'Tutor') else rnd.randint(27000, 42000), -2)

columns.name: caseload_target
columns.expr: (20 if 'Senior' in job_title else 26) if role_family == 'Coach' else None

tables.name: learners
tables.title: Learner Register
tables.description: Every apprentice enrolled since August 2023 with employer, programme, coach, dates, status, off-the-job (OTJ) hours and review dates. Confidential: personal data.

columns.name: status
columns.expr: (lambda e, s, r: (('Completed' if r < 0.81 else 'Withdrawn') if e < as_of - timedelta(days=90) else (('Gateway' if r < 0.3 else 'EPA' if r < 0.58 else 'Completed' if r < 0.72 else 'Withdrawn' if r < 0.78 else 'Active') if e < as_of + timedelta(days=60) else ('Withdrawn' if r < 0.06 and (as_of - s).days > 90 else 'Break in learning' if r < 0.09 and (as_of - s).days > 60 else 'Active'))))(d(planned_end_date), d(start_date), rnd.random())

columns.name: actual_end_date
columns.expr: min(d(planned_end_date) - timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, 45)), as_of - timedelta(days=rnd.randint(1, 20))).date().isoformat() if status == 'Completed' else ((d(start_date) + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(45, max(46, (min(d(planned_end_date), as_of) - d(start_date)).days - 5)))).date().isoformat() if status == 'Withdrawn' else None)

columns.name: withdrawal_reason
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['Left employer', 'Changed role', 'Personal / health reasons', 'Workload / unable to commit OTJ', 'Moved to a different programme', 'Redundancy', 'Programme not the right fit'], [34, 14, 16, 15, 5, 7, 9])[0]

columns.name: otj_expected_to_date
columns.expr: int(otj_hours_planned * min(1.0, ((d(actual_end_date) if actual_end_date else as_of) - d(start_date)).days / max(1, (d(planned_end_date) - timedelta(days=90) - d(start_date)).days)))

columns.name: otj_hours_logged
columns.expr: int(otj_expected_to_date * (rnd.uniform(1.0, 1.1) if status in ('Completed', 'Gateway', 'EPA') else rnd.uniform(0.45, 0.85) if status == 'Withdrawn' else rnd.choices([rnd.uniform(0.93, 1.1), rnd.uniform(0.79, 0.92), rnd.uniform(0.5, 0.78)], [70, 21, 9])[0]))

columns.name: progress_rag
columns.expr: None if status in ('Completed', 'Withdrawn') else ('Green' if otj_hours_logged >= 0.92 * otj_expected_to_date else 'Amber' if otj_hours_logged >= 0.78 * otj_expected_to_date else 'Red')

columns.name: functional_skills_required
columns.expr: rnd.choices(['None', 'Maths L2', 'English L2', 'Maths & English L2'], [74, 13, 7, 6])[0] if _level <= 3 else 'None'

tables.name: progress_reviews
tables.title: Progress Reviews
tables.description: Tripartite progress reviews (learner, employer, coach) held every 12 weeks, with OTJ hours to date and RAG rating.
tables.explode: (lambda L: [dict(x, last=(i == len(L) - 1)) for i, x in enumerate(L)])((lambda s, end, skip: (lambda R: R[:-1] if skip and R else R)([{'n': k + 1, 'date': (s + timedelta(days=42 + 84 * k + rnd.randint(-7, 7))).date().isoformat()} for k in range(60) if s + timedelta(days=42 + 84 * k + 7) < end]))(d(start_date), d(actual_end_date) if actual_end_date else as_of, status == 'Active' and rnd.random() < 0.09))

columns.name: otj_hours_to_date
columns.expr: int(base['otj_hours_logged'] * min(1.0, (d(item['date']) - d(base['start_date'])).days / max(1, ((d(base['actual_end_date']) if base['actual_end_date'] else as_of) - d(base['start_date'])).days)))

columns.name: rag
columns.expr: base['progress_rag'] if (item['last'] and base['progress_rag']) else rnd.choices(['Green', 'Amber', 'Red'], [74, 20, 6])[0]

columns.name: learner_id
columns.filter: (ref['actual_end_date'] is None or ref['actual_end_date'] > '2025-03-01') and ref['start_date'] < '2026-09-15'

columns.name: date_raised
columns.expr: (lambda a, b: (a + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, max(0, (b - a).days)))).date().isoformat())(max(d(_start) + timedelta(days=10), as_of - timedelta(days=600)), d(_end) if _end else as_of - timedelta(days=1))

columns.name: status
columns.expr: ('Open' if rnd.random() < 0.7 else 'Monitoring') if (as_of - d(date_raised)).days < 45 else ('Monitoring' if rnd.random() < 0.08 else 'Closed')

columns.name: external_referral
columns.expr: category.startswith('Prevent') or (risk_level == 'High' and rnd.random() < 0.6) or rnd.random() < 0.08

columns.name: referral_agency
columns.expr: {'Prevent / radicalisation': 'Local authority Prevent team', 'Domestic abuse': 'Local domestic abuse service', 'Self-harm / suicidal ideation': 'GP / NHS crisis team'}.get(category, choice(['Employee assistance programme', 'Local authority adult social care', 'GP', 'Citizens Advice']))

tables.name: learner_feedback
tables.title: Learner Feedback Survey
tables.description: Onboarding, mid-point and exit survey responses: NPS, coach and workshop ratings, free-text comments.

columns.name: survey
columns.expr: 'Exit survey' if _end and rnd.random() < 0.55 else choice(['Onboarding survey', 'Mid-point survey', 'Mid-point survey'])

columns.name: response_date
columns.expr: _end if survey == 'Exit survey' else (lambda a, b: (a + timedelta(days=rnd.randint(0, max(0, (b - a).days)))).date().isoformat())(d(_start) + timedelta(days=20), d(_end) if _end else as_of)

columns.name: nps_score
columns.expr: max(0, min(10, int(round(rnd.gauss(8.7 if _rag in (None, 'Green') else 7.4 if _rag == 'Amber' else 6.1, 1.4))) - (3 if _status == 'Withdrawn' else 0)))

columns.name: nps_category
columns.expr: 'Promoter' if nps_score >= 9 else ('Passive' if nps_score >= 7 else 'Detractor')

columns.name: comment
columns.expr: choice(['My coach is brilliant - always prepared and really knows the industry.', 'The live workshops are the best part; practical and relevant to my job.', 'I have already used what I learned to automate a weekly report at work.', 'Aptiva is easy to use and I like seeing my OTJ hours build up.', 'Great balance of theory and workplace projects.', 'Really supportive when I had a difficult few months.']) if nps_score >= 9 else (choice(['Good overall but some workshops feel rushed.', 'Content is useful but it is hard to find time for OTJ alongside my job.', 'Coach is good, though reviews sometimes get rescheduled.', 'Would like more examples from my sector.', 'Logging OTJ hours is a bit fiddly.']) if nps_score >= 7 else choice(['My manager does not give me time for off-the-job training.', 'Too many changes of coach.', 'I did not feel the programme matched my role.', 'Workshops clash with my shifts and recordings are not the same.', 'I have struggled with the workload and did not feel listened to.']))

post_sql: UPDATE learners SET last_review_date = (SELECT MAX(review_date) FROM progress_reviews p WHERE p.learner_id = learners.learner_id)

UPDATE learners SET next_review_due = CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('Active', 'Break in learning', 'Gateway', 'EPA') THEN NULL WHEN last_review_date IS NULL THEN date(start_date, '+42 days') ELSE date(last_review_date, '+84 days') END

derived.name: monthly_funding
derived.title: Monthly Funding by Academy
derived.description: Apprenticeship funding earned per month by academy: on-programme payments (80% of band spread over the training period) and completion payments (20% on achievement), with learner counts and new starts.
derived.sql: WITH RECURSIVE m(month_start) AS (SELECT '2024-08-01' UNION ALL SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month') FROM m WHERE month_start < '2026-10-01'), l AS (SELECT l.*, p.funding_band_gbp, p.duration_months, p.academy AS acad FROM learners l JOIN programmes p USING (programme_code)) SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', m.month_start) AS month, CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', m.month_start) AS INTEGER) >= 8 THEN strftime('%Y', m.month_start) || '/' || substr(CAST(CAST(strftime('%Y', m.month_start) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS TEXT), 3) ELSE CAST(CAST(strftime('%Y', m.month_start) AS INTEGER) - 1 AS TEXT) || '/' || substr(strftime('%Y', m.month_start), 3) END AS academic_year, l.acad AS academy, SUM(CASE WHEN l.start_date <= date(m.month_start, '+1 month', '-1 day') AND COALESCE(l.actual_end_date, '9999-12-31') >= m.month_start THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS learners_on_programme, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', l.start_date) = strftime('%Y-%m', m.month_start) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_starts, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.start_date <= date(m.month_start, '+1 month', '-1 day') AND COALESCE(l.actual_end_date, '9999-12-31') >= m.month_start AND m.month_start <= date(l.start_date, '+' || l.duration_months || ' months') AND l.status != 'Break in learning' THEN l.funding_band_gbp * 0.8 / l.duration_months ELSE 0 END), 0) AS on_programme_funding_gbp, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Completed' AND strftime('%Y-%m', l.actual_end_date) = strftime('%Y-%m', m.month_start) THEN l.funding_band_gbp * 0.2 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completion_funding_gbp FROM m CROSS JOIN l GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 3

derived.name: coach_caseloads
derived.title: Coach Caseloads
derived.description: Current caseload per coach: active learners, RAG split, overdue reviews and capacity versus target.
derived.sql: SELECT e.employee_id AS coach_id, e.full_name AS coach_name, e.academy, e.manager_id, e.caseload_target, COUNT(l.learner_id) AS active_learners, SUM(l.progress_rag = 'Green') AS green, SUM(l.progress_rag = 'Amber') AS amber, SUM(l.progress_rag = 'Red') AS red, SUM(l.next_review_due < '2026-11-05') AS overdue_reviews, ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(l.learner_id) / e.caseload_target, 2) AS capacity_used FROM employees e LEFT JOIN learners l ON l.coach_id = e.employee_id AND l.status IN ('Active', 'Break in learning', 'Gateway', 'EPA') WHERE e.role_family = 'Coach' GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.academy, e.full_name
